newsitem.title: USA: International Meta plans public offering.
newsitem.headline: International Meta plans public offering.

text.p: International Meta Systems Inc. IMES.OB) said Monday it has signed a letter of intent with a syndicate of underwriters to handle a public offering of up to $25 million of its securities.

The microprocessor company said the underwriters had made a firm commitment to proceed, adding the proposed offering was conditioned upon the listing of IMS on the Nasdaq National Market System and expected to be completed within 4 months.
IMS added that a $2.5 million bridge financing had been provided by Thomas Green Securities, to be redeemed upon the completion of the public offering.
The company said the names of the underwriters were not disclosed.
